headline: Healthy Q2 delivery, execution continues to aid

highlights: The company has evolved its offline distribution well (refer our note: Offline execution aiding overall growth) with enhanced assortment and throughput (expanded 30% YoY in Q2), which is actioned addressing the needs of channel partners.

We continue to see younger brands (which grew 45% YoY) leveraging playbook of established Mamaearth and The Derma Co (refer our note: Execution continues to outpace the FMCG pack) and they are geared to support growth needs in future.
Q2 results were ahead of expectations, with revenue growing 36% (supported by 31% volume growth), EBITDA rising 95% YoY and OPM at 12.7%, up 385bps YoY.

Beyond FY27, we forecast mid‑teen revenue CAGR over FY27–29, with margin improvement of +140bps to 14.5% in FY29, driving a robust 20% earnings CAGR. ▪ Healthy Q2FY27 topline show with 31% volume growth: Honasa delivered strong Q2 performance, with revenue up 36% and volumes growing 31.3%.
